feeds.title: Gimbal Guru
feeds.description: Gimbal Guru was founded by creative professionals looking to expand the accessibility of camera stabilizers for the indie filmmaker. From smartphone stabilizers, to 360° camera stabilizers, to GoPro stabilizers, all the way up to professional camera stabilizers like the Moza Air, Zhiyun Crane, and MOZA Pro. Gimbal Guru has the right camera stabilizer for any budget.

feeds.title: CineD » Gimbal News
feeds.description: Check out our articles about gimbal news. CineD is committed to bringing you the latest filmmaking technology news, reviews, and analysis. As a leading independent site about advancements in cinematography, we also cover filmmaking accessories, lighting, and audio as well as relevant software. Besides gear news, we provide reviews of new cameras and accessories, extensive lab tests of sensors, how-to posts and videos, behind-the-scenes talks with filmmakers, coverage of international industry trade shows, and also sometimes host filmmaking competitions.

feeds.title: Alan Glover Blog
feeds.description: Alan is a freelance Steadicam owner/operator with over 25 years experience of in shooting drama, OBs, promos, OBs, and commercials.

feeds.title: Newsshooter » Gimbals
feeds.description: Check out our archive for gimbal articles. Newsshooter.com is for working professionals shooting news, documentary, and factual projects. feeds.title: Basson Steady Blog
feeds.description: We are BASSON STEADY CAMERA STABILIZERS, manufacturers, and designers of professional wearable camera stabilizer systems. The best shop online source for filmmakers worldwide looking for the most advanced professional camera stabilizer systems. We bring to our customers the top technology in camera stabilization systems serving the community of motion picture and camera stabilization operators on five continents since 1997.

feeds.title: TONY KAY ACO Blog
feeds.description: Tony Kay ACO is a camera operator, Steadicam, and Trinity operator. He shares his work in his blog.

feeds.title: Gimbal insider Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I am Andrew Johnston. I have been interested in cameras since I was a little child. I loved taking pictures of landscapes, people, wildlife, and anything I could find. It made me really happy. My review process is quite rigorous and requires a lot of effort as I have to balance the gimbal, mount the camera with the lens, check connection features such as WiFi and USB cable, and control the camera via gimbal.
